fields.description: This discipline staffs its rooms at this branch and nothing beside them: no shift is scheduled here in any Scheduling Role that is not "Required To Staff A Room" — a floater, a lead duty, an administrative post — whatever mode it is worked in. The gating roles the rooms wait on are untouched; to close the rooms themselves, set Number of Rooms to 0. Enforced by the "Barebones branches" optimization rule, which is in the Standard Ruleset; a ruleset without it ignores this flag.
fields.label: Barebones

fields.description: Objective points a staffed room in this discipline and branch is worth, before any employee or synergy bonus — the same scale a staffed room pays under "Objective: Room utilization". 0 leaves the room-level value mechanism off for this branch. Read only by "Objective: Room value" and the employee/synergy value objectives built on it.
fields.label: Value Of A Staffed Room

fields.description: Where this band sits among bands the wall chart cannot otherwise order: a tiebreak used only between discipline-branches whose roles carry no "Display Order Key" of their own (or share the same one). 0 is the default; the chart falls back to branch then discipline name where this also ties.
fields.label: Display Order Key

fields.description: Shift Types the optimizer schedules in this discipline and branch. A Shift Type listed on no config row is treated as a non-clinical variant and excluded.
fields.label: Shift Types
